description: Mercimek Corbasi is a beloved Turkish red lentil soup, known for its vibrant color and comforting, savory flavor. This hearty soup is a staple in Turkish homes, often enjoyed with a squeeze of lemon and a drizzle of spicy melted butter. It's incredibly nourishing and surprisingly easy to prepare, perfect for any time of year.

instructions.title: Prepare Lentils and Aromatics
instructions.text: Rinse the red lentils thoroughly under cold running water until the water runs clear. Drain well. In a large pot or Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened and translucent, about 5-7 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant.

instructions.title: Build the Flavor Base
instructions.text: Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, to deepen its flavor. If using, add the flour and cook for another minute, stirring to create a roux. This helps thicken the soup slightly.

instructions.title: Combine and Simmer
instructions.text: Add the rinsed lentils to the pot. Pour in the vegetable or chicken broth. Add salt, black pepper, and half of the dried mint. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and let it simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are very tender and have broken down.

instructions.title: Blend the Soup
instructions.text: Once the lentils are tender, remove the pot from the heat. Use an immersion blender to blend the soup directly in the pot until it is smooth and creamy. If you don't have an immersion blender, carefully transfer the soup in batches to a regular blender and blend until smooth, then return it to the pot. Be cautious when blending hot liquids.

instructions.title: Prepare the Mint Butter Topping
instructions.text: While the soup is simmering or blending, prepare the traditional Turkish butter topping. In a small pan, melt the butter over medium-low heat. Once the butter is melted and slightly foaming, add the remaining dried mint and red pepper flakes. Cook for about 30 seconds, stirring frequently, until the spices are fragrant but not burnt. Remove from heat immediately.

instructions.title: Serve and Garnish
instructions.text: Ladle the hot Mercimek Corbasi into individual serving bowls. Drizzle a generous amount of the warm mint butter topping over each bowl. Serve immediately with fresh lemon wedges on the side for squeezing. A squeeze of lemon brightens the flavors beautifully.

tips: For an extra creamy texture, ensure your lentils are cooked until very soft before blending. You can also pass the blended soup through a fine-mesh sieve for ultimate smoothness.
Adjust the amount of red pepper flakes (pul biber) in the butter topping to your spice preference. For a milder soup, omit the flakes or use a sweet paprika instead.

Mercimek Corbasi tastes even better the next day. Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3-4 days. Reheat gently on the stovetop, adding a little extra broth or water if it's too thick.
